slides.title: ELBO Derivation
slides.goal: Derive the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) in variational autoencoders
equations:
\begin{align*} E(x) &= \mathbb{E}_{z \sim q(z|x)}[\log p(x|z)] \\
D(x, z) &= D_{KL}(q(z|x)||p(z))
L(x) &= E(x) - D(x, z)
\end{align*}
